en: Vintage sepia-toned postcard showing a panoramic general view of the coastal city and naval shipyards of El Ferrol. The foreground includes a long breakwater and harbor waters with several small boats; behind it stand walled arsenals, industrial buildings, and the built-up city backed by hills. Printed Spanish captions describe the scene, and the lower half and margins contain dense handwritten correspondence in ink.
